case_title: HENDRIX PATRICIA IND DBA THE ACCESSORY COLLECTION VS MOHAMMADI MOSTAFA IND DBA ITALIAN BELLA IMPORTS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $381.00 FILED BY HENDRIX PATRICIA IND DBA THE ACCESSORY COLLECTION AS TO DEFENDANT MOHAMMADI MOSTAFA IND DBA ITALIAN BELLA IMPORTS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-09-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT MOHAMMADI MOSTAFA IND DBA ITALIAN BELLA IMPORTS

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HENDRIX PATRICIA IND DBA THE ACCESSORY COLLECTION IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT MOHAMMADI MOSTAFA IND DBA ITALIAN BELLA IMPORTS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
